_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars, forks and language come live from the GitHub API on every workflow run. The description here overrides the repo's own GitHub description - go set those on GitHub too, then you can delete these overrides.

projects.description: One API for building AI agents across LLM providers. Swap the provider without rewriting the app. Published on npm.
A self-consistency answer engine. Runs a question down several reasoning paths and returns the answer they agree on.
A content-planning calendar for scheduling and tracking posts, backed by a real database.
A streaming AI chat application built on the LLM APIs directly, no framework in between.
